messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: We just confirmed the pen-test window for Tue 2026-04-07 09:00-17:00 UTC. Scope: RBAC delta review, KMS key wrapping checks, and audit-log export verification. Assessor requested timeboxed, non-decrypt access + cryptographic proof of log delivery.

sandeep: I can own the ephemeral role creation. TTL = 8h? recommend 6h to be safe. Also need a pre-signed S3 exporter with SSE-KMS and versioning enabled.

alex: RBAC mapping question: are we giving the assessor iam:PassRole to transient infra roles? prefer to avoid PassRole; instead create scoped assessor roles per service and attach policy directly.

lara: oncall: please confirm we have two engineers available during the whole window + a separate pager for retest. I'll publish the rota in #oncall. Need rollback PR link for any auth flips.

ben: KMS notes: we'll not grant kms:Decrypt. We'll grant kms:GenerateDataKey for wrapping and kms:Encrypt for the presign process. The assessor will never see plaintext keys. Will draft a policy.

maria: good. we also need an immutable audit trail: object-level checksums + signed manifest in ticket. @sec-bot can we attach a signature to the export job?

sec-bot: Automated: yes. Evidence pipeline will produce a SHA256 manifest and sign with platform key alias "alias/pt-evidence-signer". Presigned link TTL = 24h. Scrubbing rules will be applied per sec-team guidance.

sandeep: draft policy below (will tighten after review):
```
Effect: Allow
Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-temp
Action: kms:GenerateDataKey,kms:Encrypt
Condition: StringEquals: {"kms:EncryptionContext": "pt-session"}
Deny: kms:Decrypt,kms:ReEncrypt*
```

alex: also add logging: require kms:ViaService condition to ensure calls come from the export lambda/service only.

lara: runbook checklist (stub):
- create/approve assessor role PR (#4897)
- enable debug logs for inference-proxy 08:45-17:15 UTC
- create s3 export bucket with lifecycle 90d->archive after 30d
- attach scrub regex v2.2
- tag ticket with pt-evidence & pt-retest-request
- sign evidence manifest
Link: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pt-window-2026

oncall-runbook: added a page for the window with escalation matrix and a one-click rollback webhook. Please sign off before EOD.

ben: telemetry ask: capture request_id, model_commit, quant_flags, and sampling_seed in audit line. This helps correlate findings with perf regressions.

eva: remediation owner here. After fixes land, tag the ticket `pt-ready-for-retest` and @lara will schedule a 1h retest slot within 96h. I'll ensure unit tests and e2e checks for RBAC are green before requesting retest.

maria: final ops: everyone who modifies access must post the PR number in the ticket and attach a signed evidence statement. We'll need that for the retest checklist.

sandeep: terraform branch pushed: https://git.redwood/infra/pt-access/assessor-temp-4897. PR #4897. Please review IAM+KMS scope.

alex: reviewing now. flagged 2 minor perms to tighten. will comment in PR.

maria: thanks. I'll close the loop after PR approvals and post the final checklist. Reminder: limit presigned URL exposure and rotate alias/key after the engagement.

lara: reminder set for 24h notice. :thumbsup:

maria: closing thread — owners assigned.
